posts.title: House of Bleu | Premium client reactivation

copy.default:
Premium reactivation works differently from cold acquisition.

The people behind this result had already trusted the clinic once.

That changes the job.

Inside 222Emails, we treated the existing relationship as the starting point: identify the right dormant clients, reopen the conversation with context, then make the return path easy.

The result shown in the case study came from one dormant treatment-client segment over 14 days.

What I like most about this type of work is how little noise it needs. Strong prior trust means the follow-up can feel like service, not advertising.

For clinic owners, the useful question is simple:

Where does your current rebooking process actually stop?

posts.mediaAlt: 222Emails client case study for House of Bleu showing a 14-day reactivation campaign, client re-engagement, treatment conversations, appointments booked and attributable potential booking value.
